data.narrative:
Skyrora is a private-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised $66M to date. The broader sector comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs. This peer universe spans early-stage through late-stage capital structures.

Peer-median valuation is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints within the narrowed peer set; filtering for stage and valuation tier yielded fewer than 3 comparable companies. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples is likewise not applicable, as Skyrora's revenue is not disclosed—a standard limitation when valuing private companies. The public sector median P/S multiple stands at 24.6x across 6 traded aerospace companies, providing context but not a direct input without revenue data.

No triangulated valuation can be reliably derived from available quantitative methods. A defensible range would require either: (1) disclosed or estimated revenue paired with the 24.6x public median, adjusted downward for private-company and stage risk; or (2) sufficient same-stage private comparables with known funding and valuation data. At $66M raised, Skyrora likely commands a post-money valuation above deployment capital, but the magnitude cannot be quantified from the data at hand. Further disclosure of revenue or analogous transaction data is necessary to establish valuation support.
